answer: Each epoch samples 4% of submissions for a full audit, and an identity gets paid once per epoch no matter how many answers it files. The contrarian read: sampling does not deter a farm that plans to lose 4%, it catches them a close later, which is enough when payouts vest. Example: an island of 1,000 clones sees 40 audits a tide, each split by a prism into three reviewers; 9 in 10 fail, so the farm burns 36 stakes to bank one epoch.
